crossRefs.note: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations.
For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.
Don’t turn away to go after vain things which can’t profit or deliver, for they are vain.
for all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, which they sinned, and with which they made Israel to sin, to…
For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sins with which he made Israel to sin, to provoke…
I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in Yahweh.
Behold, the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people from a land that is very far off: “Isn’t Yahweh in Zion?…
But they are together brutish and foolish, instructed by idols! It is just wood.
Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain? Or can the sky give showers? Aren’t you he, Yahweh…
Those who regard lying vanities forsake their own mercy.
As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.
Yet the number of the children of Israel will be as the sand of the sea, which can’t be measured or counted; and it…
As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not…
But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says, “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation. I will…
I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the…
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim…
In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

translations.web: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will move them to jealousy with those who are not a people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
translations.bsb: They have provoked My jealousy by that which is not God; they have enraged Me with their worthless idols. So I will make them jealous by those who are not a people; I will make them angry by a nation without understanding.
translations.kjv: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
translations.asv: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; They have provoked me to anger with their vanities: And I will move them to jealousy with those that are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
